spec_basis: [STU-SHL-008] Naming law binding. No vendor product name is a Studio menu title, submenu, leaf, panel, region, tool, family, Layout Preset, Task Scope, command id or manual anchor. Vendor names appear ... ONLY as capture provenance ... or in an explanatory note
[STU-SHL-252] The naming law applies to every generated string ... A generated display_name containing a vendor product name is a build failure ([STU-SHL-251])

[STU-SECTION-003] a source suite's product name (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Affinity, Photo, Designer, Publisher, Figma, FigJam, and so on) is never a Studio tool, command, panel, or manual name

[STU-ARC-014] Controls MUST implement one reusable panel/control mechanic with typed capability configuration for text fields, sliders, swatches, menus, windows ... The same descriptors MUST feed structured tools, AccessKit, UserManual and Argus
[STU-SHL-004] the shell menu bar carries eight menus ... Studio contributes leaves into FILE, EDIT, VIEW and HELP

[STU-SHL-037] HELP: Studio Manual (Open Studio Manual, Search Manual…, Help for This Command, Help for This Panel, Help for This Tool, Domain Guides…), Full Command Index… (menu-only), Keyboard Shortcut Reference…, Diagnostics (Render Harness…, Visual Debugger, Flight Recorder, Validation Report…, System Report…, GPU Report…, Accessibility Tree Snapshot…; menu-only), About Studio
[STU-SHL-017] menu invariants MENU-INV-2 (one id per primary leaf), MENU-INV-4 (one availability evaluation feeds every renderer), MENU-INV-5 (author_id menu.{command_id})
[STU-SHL-018] The menu NEVER hides ... INAPPLICABLE_HERE renders greyed with its reason and its remedy. NOT_IN_THIS_DOCUMENT renders greyed with its reason
[STU-SHL-019] Machine-readable disabled_reason readable through tooltip, AccessKit node and command API with identical content
[STU-SHL-020] Every INAPPLICABLE_HERE state MUST carry a remedy_command_id naming ONE enabled command ... The menu renders the remedy as an enabled sibling leaf
[STU-SHL-021] Maximum depth including registry expansion is 4
[STU-SHL-050] three states AVAILABLE / INAPPLICABLE_HERE / NOT_IN_THIS_DOCUMENT; [STU-SHL-051] twelve reason codes (closed)

[STU-SHL-009] / [STU-CMP-110] / [STU-QUIET-005] headlessly inspectable and steerable, no foreground window, no focus steal: every new surface is driven by Viewer methods and state_json, drawn into a bare egui::Context in tests
